title: Peanut Tofu Bowl
style: Golden pan-fried tofu simmered in a sticky peanut, coconut and sriracha sauce, piled over rice with peanuts and coriander
description: Tofu fried until golden, then simmered for five minutes in a creamy sauce of peanut butter, coconut milk, soy, honey, sriracha and chilli oil. Served over rice with crushed peanuts and coriander — about 1040 kcal and 48 g protein per serving.

items.note: 1 block, pressed and cut into bite-sized cubes

steps: Prep the tofu: Press the tofu, cut into bite-sized cubes and season with salt and pepper.
Fry: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu, turning occasionally, until golden on all sides.
Sauce: Meanwhile, whisk the peanut butter, honey, sriracha, soy sauce, rice vinegar, chilli oil and coconut milk together in a bowl until smooth.
Simmer: Pour the sauce over the tofu in the pan and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy.
Serve over rice, topped with the peanuts and coriander, with steamed broccoli on the side if you like.
tips: Press the tofu well so it browns properly before the sauce goes in.
Use maple syrup instead of honey to make it vegan.
If the sauce gets too thick, loosen it with a splash of water.
